about: Each reading converted from the live app and the L story it shows (migrate/reading.mjs storyFor), frozen on 2026-11-25 from the written files at 536d61b. A rerun takes a reading's story from its own file (story_id) first and from here only when the file is missing, never from the reading's unit position. A reading written in content/ only names its story in its own file.
